title: Searching NOT in capitals with a leading space lists untracked parts plus normal matches on not
custom_preconds:
• At least two untracked parts and one tracked part whose description contains "not" (e.g. "*DO NOT ORDER/USE*").
  • Parts > Inventory, Active tab.
custom_steps: 1. Type " NOT" (leading space, capitals) in the search box.
custom_expected:
Step 1:

  • Every untracked active part is listed, each showing Not Tracked.
  • Tracked parts whose number, description or tags contain "not" are listed too (e.g. *DO NOT ORDER/USE*).
  • No other tracked parts are listed.
